facts.fact: The Diffa regional directorate of civil status (DRECM-R) reports, in its July 2023 to July 2026 review, the computerisation of four communes of the Diffa region, with four administrateurs délégués, four departmental civil-status directors and nine civil-status agents trained in the digital tools; it gives no total of communes and the count is for one region only.

The Diffa regional directorate says its actions over July 2023 to July 2026, the computerisation of four communes among them, were carried out with the support of UNICEF and other technical and financial partners; no domestic budget line is mentioned.

The computerisation of four communes in Diffa is reported by, and as an action of, the Direction régionale de l'État civil, des Migrations et des Réfugiés of Diffa, the Interior Ministry's regional service (July 2026).
